tours.name: Inventory User Guide - Stock Valuation by Product & Category

name_i18n.en_US: Inventory User Guide - Stock Valuation by Product & Category

tours.description: How to check inventory valuation in Odoo: open the Stock Valuation report and group it by product category and product, read the Total Value, check a product's cost, review the costing method, inventory valuation mode and stock valuation account on the product category, and view unit cost and total value per category in the Stock report.

steps.title: Standard Price First In First Out (FIFO)

title_i18n.en_US: Standard Price First In First Out (FIFO)

title_i18n.ta_IN: Standard Price First In First Out (FIFO)

steps.content:
Standard Price: The products are valued at their standard cost defined on the product.
        Average Cost (AVCO): The products are valued at weighted average cost.
        First In First Out (FIFO): The products are valued supposing those that enter the company first will also leave it first.

steps.title: Manual Automated
steps.content:
Manual: The accounting entries to value the inventory are not posted automatically.
        Automated: An accounting entry is automatically created to value the inventory when a product enters or leaves the company.
